definitions.explanation: A chemical compound made up only of carbon and hydrogen atoms. Hydrocarbons are the main components of petroleum and natural gas.

examples.japanese: {炭化水素|たんかすいそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炭化水素|たんかすいそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{混合物|こんごうぶつ}→混合物：21415_kongoubutsu⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Petroleum is a mixture of hydrocarbons.

examples.japanese: {炭化水素|たんかすいそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}→二酸化炭素：04630_nisankatanso⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When hydrocarbons burn, carbon dioxide and water are produced.

notes:
Combines ⟦{炭素|たんそ}→炭素：06583_tanso⟧ (carbon) and ⟦{水素|すいそ}→水素：00387_suiso⟧ (hydrogen). Hydrocarbons are the basic building blocks of fuels such as petroleum and natural gas.
